instruction: Change the color theme in VS Code to Solarized Light.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "workbench.colorTheme" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"workbench.colorTheme": "[^"]*"/"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VSCode color theme to Solarized Light. Uses the same evaluator structure (compare_config metric + vm_file getter) as the original task. Solarized Light is a built-in VSCode theme.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can verify the instruction properly
Metric (check_json_settings) correctly parses JSON and checks if 'workbench.colorTheme': 'Solarized Light' exists
Metric allows other settings to coexist in settings.json (does not require exact file match)
Expected value 'Solarized Light' is correct - it's a real VSCode built-in theme
Coverage is complete - verifies the exact requirement from the instruction
